definitions.render_tail_ms: (g1.last_render_end_frame - trigger.frame) * 1000 / context_rate; exclusive AudioContext frame boundaries
definitions.controlled_stale_probe: full cases only; controlled receive matched to worklet stale_probe generation_fence by generation/offset/samples; ordinary late frames excluded
definitions.assistant_history: server g1 segments with end <= reported playback; compare their concatenated text to actual g2 assistant prompt messages
definitions.quantiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; values_ms contains every measured case
definitions.scope: explicit playback-position trigger; render consumption proxy, no microphone onset, VAD, acoustic stop, or client/server clock subtraction
